```csharp
using System;
using System.Runtime.InteropServices;
using Microsoft.Extensions.Logging;
using Moq;
using Xunit;
using Garnet.cluster;
using Garnet.common;

namespace Garnet.Tests.cluster
{
    public class ReplicationManagerTests
    {
        private class TestReplicationManager : ReplicationManager
        {
            public TestReplicationManager(ILogger logger, ClusterProviderMock clusterProvider)
            {
                this.logger = logger;
                this.clusterProvider = clusterProvider;
                this.activeReplay = new ActiveReplayMock();
                this.storeWrapper = clusterProvider.storeWrapper;
                this.ReplicationOffset = 0;
                this.pageSizeBits = 12; // typical 4KB page size
            }

            public new ILogger logger;
            public new ClusterProviderMock clusterProvider;
            public new ActiveReplayMock activeReplay;
            public new StoreWrapperMock storeWrapper;
            public new long ReplicationOffset;
            public new int pageSizeBits;

            public void CallProcessPrimaryStream(byte[] recordBytes, int recordLength, long previousAddress, long currentAddress, long nextAddress)
            {
                unsafe
                {
                    fixed (byte* p = recordBytes)
                    {
                        ProcessPrimaryStream(p, recordLength, previousAddress, currentAddress, nextAddress);
                    }
                }
            }
        }

        private class ClusterProviderMock
        {
            public ClusterManagerMock clusterManager = new ClusterManagerMock();
            public ServerOptionsMock serverOptions = new ServerOptionsMock();
            public ReplicationManagerMock replicationManager = new ReplicationManagerMock();
            public StoreWrapperMock storeWrapper = new StoreWrapperMock();
        }

        private class ClusterManagerMock
        {
            public ClusterConfigMock CurrentConfig = new ClusterConfigMock();
        }

        private class ClusterConfigMock
        {
            public NodeRole LocalNodeRole = NodeRole.REPLICA;
            public string LocalNodeId = "node-1";
        }

        private class ServerOptionsMock
        {
            public int ReplicationOffsetMaxLag = 0;
            public bool FastAofTruncate = false;
            public bool EnableFastCommit = false;
        }

        private class ReplicationManagerMock
        {
            public bool CannotStreamAOF = false;
        }

        private class StoreWrapperMock
        {
            public ServerOptionsMock serverOptions = new ServerOptionsMock();
            public AppendOnlyFileMock appendOnlyFile = new AppendOnlyFileMock();
            public DefaultDatabaseMock DefaultDatabase = new DefaultDatabaseMock();
        }

        private class AppendOnlyFileMock
        {
            public long TailAddress = 0;

            public void SafeInitialize(long a, long b) { }

            public object UnsafeEnqueueRaw(Span<byte> span, bool noCommit)
            {
                return null;
            }

            public object ScanSingle(long previousAddress, object lo)
            {
                return null;
            }
        }

        private class DefaultDatabaseMock
        {
            public VectorManagerMock VectorManager = new VectorManagerMock();
        }

        private class VectorManagerMock
        {
            public void WaitForVectorOperationsToComplete() { }
        }

        private class ActiveReplayMock
        {
            public bool TryReadLock() => true;
        }

        [Fact]
        public void ProcessPrimaryStream_LogsError_WhenCannotStreamAOF()
        {
            // Arrange
            var loggerMock = new Mock<ILogger>();
            var clusterProvider = new ClusterProviderMock();
            clusterProvider.replicationManager.CannotStreamAOF = true;
            var manager = new TestReplicationManager(loggerMock.Object, clusterProvider);

            // Act & Assert
            var ex = Assert.Throws<GarnetException>(() =>
            {
                manager.CallProcessPrimaryStream(new byte[1], 1, 0, 0, 0);
            });

            Assert.Contains("Replica is recovering cannot sync AOF", ex.Message);

            loggerMock.Verify(
                x => x.Log(
                    LogLevel.Error,
                    It.IsAny<EventId>(),
                    It.Is<It.IsAnyType>((v, t) => v.ToString().Contains("Replica is recovering cannot sync AOF")),
                    null,
                    It.IsAny<Func<It.IsAnyType, Exception, string>>()),
                Times.Once);
        }
    }
}
```

The class ReplicationManager is internal sealed, so we cannot subclass it or access it directly from tests outside the assembly. Also, the logger is a private field. We cannot easily inject a mock logger or intercept the logger calls.

Since the code calls logger?.LogError on line 49, and we want to test that call, the best approach is to create a wrapper interface for the logger and inject it, or parameterize the dependency on the logger. However, the apply_refactor tool is not available.

Given the constraints, I will write a test class inside the same namespace Garnet.cluster and use InternalsVisibleTo attribute if it exists in the assembly to access internal types. If not, I will create a partial class in the test project to access the internal members.

Alternatively, I can create a minimal test class in the same namespace and use reflection to set the private logger field to a mock ILogger.

I will try to read the assembly info or project files to check if InternalsVisibleTo is set for the test project.

I will list the root directory to find the project files or assembly info files.

```csharp
using System;
using System.Reflection;
using Microsoft.Extensions.Logging;
using Moq;
using Xunit;
using Garnet.common;

namespace Garnet.cluster.Tests
{
    public class ReplicationManagerTests
    {
        private static void SetPrivateField(object obj, string fieldName, object value)
        {
            var field = obj.GetType().GetField(fieldName, BindingFlags.Instance | BindingFlags.NonPublic);
            if (field == null)
                throw new InvalidOperationException($"Field '{fieldName}' not found on type '{obj.GetType().FullName}'");
            field.SetValue(obj, value);
        }

        [Fact]
        public void ProcessPrimaryStream_LogsError_WhenCannotStreamAOF()
        {
            // Arrange
            var type = Type.GetType("Garnet.cluster.ReplicationManager, Garnet");
            Assert.NotNull(type);
            var ctor = type.GetConstructor(BindingFlags.Instance | BindingFlags.NonPublic | BindingFlags.Public, null, Type.EmptyTypes, null);
            Assert.NotNull(ctor);
            var manager = ctor.Invoke(null);

            var clusterProviderField = type.GetField("clusterProvider", BindingFlags.Instance | BindingFlags.NonPublic);
            Assert.NotNull(clusterProviderField);
            var clusterProvider = clusterProviderField.GetValue(manager);

            var replicationManagerField = clusterProvider.GetType().GetField("replicationManager", BindingFlags.Instance | BindingFlags.Public | BindingFlags.NonPublic);
            Assert.NotNull(replicationManagerField);
            var replicationManager = replicationManagerField.GetValue(clusterProvider);

            var cannotStreamAofField = replicationManager.GetType().GetField("CannotStreamAOF", BindingFlags.Instance | BindingFlags.Public | BindingFlags.NonPublic);
            Assert.NotNull(cannotStreamAofField);
            cannotStreamAofField.SetValue(replicationManager, true);

            var loggerMock = new Mock<ILogger>();
            SetPrivateField(manager, "logger", loggerMock.Object);

            // Prepare dummy record data
            byte[] recordBytes = new byte[1] { 0x00 };

            unsafe
            {
                fixed (byte* p = recordBytes)
                {
                    var method = type.GetMethod("ProcessPrimaryStream", BindingFlags.Instance | BindingFlags.Public);
                    // Act & Assert
                    var ex = Assert.Throws<TargetInvocationException>(() =>
                    {
                        method.Invoke(manager, new object[] { (IntPtr)p, 1, 0L, 0L, 0L });
                    });
                    // The actual exception is inner exception
                    Assert.IsType<GarnetException>(ex.InnerException);
                    Assert.Contains("Replica is recovering cannot sync AOF", ex.InnerException.Message);
                }
            }

            loggerMock.Verify(
                x => x.Log(
                    LogLevel.Error,
                    It.IsAny<EventId>(),
                    It.Is<It.IsAnyType>((v, t) => v.ToString().Contains("Replica is recovering cannot sync AOF")),
                    null,
                    It.IsAny<Func<It.IsAnyType, Exception, string>>()),
                Times.Once);
        }
    }
}
```
